verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm stack explicitly lists the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as supported for PyTorch and JAX. Linux also gets TensorFlow and ONNX, and AMD documents vLLM and SGLang setup with prebuilt Docker images. That gives developers a real, documented first-party SDK path to build against. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that development on this card works as documented, explicit evidence of the low-level SDK APIs (e.g. HIP libraries) beyond framework support, and parity on Windows, which is limited to PyTorch.
